experiments.title: Hybrid retrieval vs vector-only
experiments.hypothesis: Hybrid retrieval increases evidence precision without unacceptable latency.

experiments.title: Entity extraction pipeline
experiments.hypothesis: NER + LLM verifier reduces missed entities and duplicate graph nodes.

experiments.title: GPT emulator vs local Qwen
experiments.hypothesis: Local Qwen reaches target quality with lower cost for collector tasks.

experiments.title: Model router policy
experiments.hypothesis: Capability-aware routing beats fixed-model routing on balanced score.

qualityGates.title: Dataset Gate
qualityGates.rule: Dataset version fixed; same cases for all compared variants.

qualityGates.title: Evaluator Gate
qualityGates.rule: Scorer/judge version fixed and calibrated on human-gold sample.

qualityGates.title: Regression Gate
qualityGates.rule: Candidate must pass historical failures and protected capabilities.

qualityGates.title: Safety Gate
qualityGates.rule: No promotion when red-team or policy thresholds regress.

datasets.title: Regression
datasets.purpose: Previously fixed failures and protected behavior.

datasets.title: Adversarial
datasets.purpose: Attacks, malformed inputs and hostile contexts.

datasets.title: Production Failures
datasets.purpose: Real failures promoted into future tests.
